title: Valerie L NDE 1039
content: On April 25, 2003 I was rushed to the hospital by ambulance because I was not able to breathe. I had lost about forty-seven percent of my oxygen, which was not good. I don't remember the ride to the hospital. But from the time I left my body during that time I was floating to what I thought was heaven, I saw a bright light like I had never seen before. I felt a peace and serene feeling; this was peace was indescribable. Then I looked up and there was my grandfather with open arms. He said he would take care of me. I looked to my left and I saw my two children telling me to come back. And I came back.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Uncertain Illness PMEMONIA COULDN'T BREATH. SUFFOCATING. Illness, trauma or other condition not considered life threatening Not sure what you mean.
elements.The experience included: Out of body experience | Presence of deceased persons | Light
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: Yes I left my body several times during this whole ordeal. After I came back, my mother decided to hook me up to respiratory so I would live. I left my body, the doctors and my family were making decisions about me that I disagreed with. I even described the furniture to my family that was in that room. Then I was put into a drug-induced coma. I heard nurses tell people I couldn't hear them in the coma. I heard people the whole time.
elements.At what time during the experience were: I seemed as if I was awake but somewhere else.
elements.Did you pass into or through a tunnel?: Uncertain It was just a big bright light for me!
elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: Yes So bright that it took me months to be able to tolerate regular light without sunglasses.
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm Heaven.
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Yes I believe now that we must trust God and really no one else because they will always disappoint you and let you down. I don't know that I will ever be physically or mentally stable.
elements.Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or: Yes Sometimes I get feelings about things and usually they're right.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: The best was seeing the light and my grandfather. The worst is seeing my family act like fools.
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes One person believes me, very much so. I believe my mother even believes me now. I stay to myself a lot.
elements.Are there any other questions that we co: Question do we ever go back to being normal or have normal lives again. I just don't feel as if I belong here anymore.
